items.title: The newest .NET
items.detail: Exo Cinema runs on .NET 10.0.14, with Microsoft's latest fixes.

items.title: Your add-on link stays private
items.detail: Settings shows a saved add-on link as dots, so it never shows up in a screenshot or a stream.

items.title: A log that's safe to share
items.detail: app.log no longer keeps web addresses, keys, titles or your server's name, so you can attach it to a problem report as it is.

items.title: Newer mpv and FFmpeg
items.detail: The player is on the newest builds of mpv and FFmpeg.

items.title: The picture picks itself
items.detail: High quality on a dedicated graphics card, Balanced on integrated graphics or battery, and lighter for a video that starts dropping frames. Picture is gone from Settings.

items.title: Hardware decoding, always
items.detail: Video is decoded on your graphics card, and in software only when the card can't, so its switch is gone too.

items.title: AI upscaling on RTX cards
items.detail: A video smaller than your screen is sharpened by NVIDIA's RTX Video Super Resolution as it plays, when it's on in Exo Launcher's PC > Display.

items.title: Games come first
items.detail: While Exo Launcher has a game running, the upscaler steps aside so the game keeps its graphics card.

items.title: Updates that wait
items.detail: An update waits a few seconds for Exo Cinema's last helpers to close, instead of stopping at "folder in use".

items.title: The best version, every time
items.detail: When your server has a title in more than one version, Play picks the best one for this PC: one it can play as is, in the sharpest picture your graphics card is built for.

items.title: Or choose it yourself
items.detail: Settings > Playback > Source on Ask shows every version when you press Play, with its picture, size and sound, the best one marked.

items.title: Skip where you look
items.detail: Skip intro and Up Next sit at the right of the screen, larger and higher, clear of the controls.

items.title: Rows that page
items.detail: Arrows beside each row's name move it a page at a time, as in Exo Launcher's Store.

items.title: Pictures that lift
items.detail: Point at a poster or an episode and it rises a little toward you, as in Exo Launcher.

items.title: No white boxes
items.detail: Focus rings show only when you move with Tab, never after a click, and the search field has none.

items.title: Play starts playing
items.detail: A second click on Play no longer lands on the picture and pauses the video as it opens.

items.title: Search answers sooner
items.detail: Search asks your server only for what its list shows, so a large library answers in about a second instead of up to thirteen.

items.title: Search shows it is looking
items.detail: A spinner turns in the field while your server looks, and No matches or the reason shows when nothing comes back.

items.title: No ring on What's New
items.detail: What's New no longer opens with a white ring around Continue.

items.title: Your Jellyfin library
items.detail: Sign in to your server and everything you watch is here: Home, your libraries, shows by season, and search with Ctrl+K.

items.title: Progress that follows you
items.detail: Where you stop and what you've watched go back to Jellyfin as you watch, so every Jellyfin app picks up where you left off.

items.title: A native player
items.detail: mpv draws the picture with hardware decoding, HDR and Dolby Vision tone mapping, at the video's own frame rate.

items.title: Liquid Glass over the picture
items.detail: The controls blur the video under them as it plays, drawn on the graphics card at no cost to playback.

items.title: Audio, subtitles and speed
items.detail: One menu at the top right; each show remembers the languages you pick.

items.title: Skip intro and Up Next
items.detail: Skip openings and credits, and the next episode plays on its own unless you say not now.

items.title: A Home that opens at once
items.detail: Rows and pictures are kept on this PC, so Home draws before your server answers.
